scene.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — chest-deep in the water; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — fans her neck with a folding fan; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — crouching low on her heels; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — bites the corner off an ice pop on a wooden stick; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds her keepsake up beside her face
